faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about DexSpace and how you can make the most of our platform.

item-1.title: What is DexSpace?
item-1.description: DexSpace is a next-gen DeFi analytics platform that provides real-time token prices, market trends, and advanced trading insights for decentralized exchanges.

item-2.title: How does DexSpace track token prices?
item-2.description: DexSpace utilizes advanced blockchain indexing technology to monitor on-chain transactions and liquidity pools across multiple networks. We aggregate data from decentralized exchanges and provide real-time price updates with minimal latency, ensuring you always have the most current market information.

item-3.title: Do I need to connect my wallet to use DexSpace?
item-3.description: No, you don't need to connect your wallet to access basic features like token price tracking, market trends, and analytics. However, connecting your wallet enables personalized features such as portfolio tracking, trading directly from our platform, and receiving customized alerts based on your holdings.

item-4.title: Is DexSpace free to use?
item-4.description: Yes, DexSpace offers a free tier that provides access to essential features including token price tracking, basic market analytics, and trading insights. We also offer premium subscription plans with advanced features like real-time alerts, enhanced data visualization, API access, and priority customer support for professional traders and developers.

item-5.title: How can I list a token on DexSpace?
item-5.description: To list your token on DexSpace, you can submit a listing request through our Token Submission portal. We require basic information about your project, including contract address, website, social media links, and tokenomics details. Our team reviews all submissions to ensure they meet our security and quality standards before adding them to our platform.

faq.support: Still have questions? Contact Support. contact@dexspace.io

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: DexSpace ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our decentralized exchange analytics platform. By using DexSpace, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

provided.title: 2.1 Information You Provide
provided.item1: Wallet addresses when you connect your wallet
provided.item2: Email addresses (if you choose to provide them for authentication)

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.item1: Provide and maintain our platform services
usage.item2: Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience
usage.item3: Detect and prevent fraud or security threats
usage.item4: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
usage.item6: Provide customer support and respond to inquiries

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share information in the following circumstances:
sharing.item1: Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect our rights
sharing.item2: Service Providers: With trusted third-party service providers who assist in platform operations
sharing.item3: Security: To prevent fraud, abuse, or security threats
sharing.item4: Consent: When you explicitly consent to sharing

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

blockchain.title: 6. Blockchain and Public Data
blockchain.content: Please note that blockchain transactions are inherently public and transparent. When you interact with blockchain networks through our platform, transaction data becomes publicly available on the blockchain. We cannot control or modify this public data once it has been recorded on the blockchain.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
cookies.item4: Ensure platform security and prevent fraud
cookies.note: You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences, though disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights and Choices
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
rights.item1: Access: Request information about the data we hold about you
rights.item2: Correction: Request correction of inaccurate data
rights.item3: Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data
rights.item4: Portability: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
rights.item5: Objection: Object to certain types of data processing
rights.item6: Withdrawal: Withdraw consent for data processing

retention.title: 9. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. The retention period may vary depending on the type of data and its purpose.

international.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.

children.title: 11. Children's Privacy
children.content: DexSpace is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. Your continued use of DexSpace after such changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
